crossRefs.note: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother…

parallels.note: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another;

translations.web: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
translations.bsb: This is My command to you: Love one another.
translations.kjv: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
translations.asv: These things I command you, that ye may love one another.
